dish: shio-tan (salted tongue), marbled rōsu and tetchan grilled over charcoal
n: Sumibi Yakiniku Ōkura (炭火焼肉 大倉, Tsuruhashi)
address: 1-63 Higashiuemachi, Tennōji-ku, Osaka (under the JR Tsuruhashi tracks)
w: Charcoal yakiniku under the JR Tsuruhashi viaduct. Rurubu and Mapple both list it for domestic wagyu (much of it from Kyushu), butchered before opening and never frozen; it doesn't open if the owner can't buy meat he likes. Mapple names the shio-tan, rōsu and tetchan.

dish: Takaida-kei chūka soba: extra-thick straight noodles in a chicken-based, dark-shōyu soup
n: Chūkasoba Kōyōken (中華そば 光洋軒)
w: Started as a yatai in 1953, near Fuse Station. nippon.com's Osaka ramen series profiles it as the birthplace of Takaida-kei, the thick-noodle shōyu ramen of Higashi-Ōsaka and Higashinari. Kansai Walker's Takaida-kei four-shop guide names it the style's originating shop.

dish: goat sashimi, gōyā champurū and chiragā (pig-face skin), with Orion beer and awamori
w: A Little Okinawa folk-song tavern with a big stage. A min'yō show runs every night and ends in kachāshī dancing. Kansai Walker's Taishō min'yō-bar feature cites its 50-plus Okinawan home-style dishes, and the owner runs sanshin lessons on weekend mornings. Mapple lists the goat sashimi, gōyā champurū and chiragā.

dish: griddled horumon (yaki-horumon) and Okinawan pork cuts: skin-on pork, chiragā (pig-face skin), offal
n: Nakasone Seinikuten (仲宗根精肉店, Hirao)
w: A Hirao pork butcher that supplies Little Okinawa's restaurants. It stocks cuts ordinary butchers don't carry, such as skin-on pork, chiragā and offal, all domestic pork, and its griddled horumon is a takeaway favourite. Featured by Kansai Walker's Little Okinawa guide and OSAKA-INFO's Little Okinawa article.

dish: Ikuno-style okonomiyaki with kimchi, aburakasu (fried beef intestine), negi and beef suji
address: 1-14-16 Kujō, Nishi-ku, Osaka (1 min from Kujō Stn exit 6)
w: Kujō okonomiyaki shop, about 20 years old. The name is Korean for 'friend', and the owner trained at Omoni in Ikuno. A Tabelog Okonomiyaki Hyakumeiten 2023 pick, and Osaka Metro's Osaka Mania okonomiyaki series cites its kimchi-and-aburakasu Ikuno-style okonomiyaki.
